rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for conscious understanding of something.

example.english: My perception of this matter is still not deep enough.
example.traditional: 我對呢件事嘅理解仲未夠深入。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 nei1 gin6 si6 ge3 lei5 gaai2 zung6 mei6 gau3 sam1 jap6

rows.note: Use this for ordinary, subjective sensory perception rather than the technical process of processing sensory information.

example.english: My perception of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy tastes is very sensitive.
example.traditional: 我對甜酸苦辣嘅感覺好敏銳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 tim4 syun1 fu2 laat6 ge3 gam2 gok3 hou2 man5 jeoi6

rows.note: Use this for the technical or psychological sense of sensory perception and its interpretation.

example.english: After the stroke, their perception was affected.
example.traditional: 中風之後，佢嘅知覺受到影響。
example.jyutping: zung3 fung1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 ge3 zi1 gok3 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2
